caption: Aventine Keyhole, Rome
composition: Priory gate keyhole framing St. Peter’s dome down a cypress alley · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist bends to the famous keyhole in the priory's green door, and through the round opening appears the dome of St. Peter's, perfectly framed at the end of a cypress-lined alley. The stone portal fills the center of the frame, flanked by weathered walls with a small green side door on the left, and cobblestones in the foreground. The 11:55 sun is bright under a clear blue sky, and the tiny revealed view glows at the end of the dark green avenue.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Aventine Keyhole under late-morning light
